name: STM32F405 (pyboard)
notes: Pins are named, not numbered: X1-X12 and X17-X22 (left), Y1-Y12 (right), as printed on the board. X13-X16 are reset, ground and power, not GPIO. SPI and I2C pins are the pyboard's own hardware mappings; SPI is limited to 21 MHz (SPI2's limit -- SPI1 can go faster). The pyboard's four LEDs are pyb.LED(1-4), not header pins.
